[All Platforms 📱💻🎮]

🥊OVER 250 FIGHTER CARDS TO COLLECT!🥊

CODE: Release!

Build your roster with randoms, real fighters and REAL LEGENDS. Enter official matches against NPCS or put them up against other PLAYERS FIGHTERS and bet money on them winning! Train their stats and watch them develop into champions.

This is a different kind of boxing experience on Roblox. You do not control the punches—you watch the fighter in INTENSE matches and train their strengths and weaknesses. Upgrade your gym, improve your roster, climb through stronger leagues, and let your fighters prove themselves in the ring.

⭐Make sure to like, favorite, and join the group for updates, new fighters, codes and in-game rewards.⭐

THIS GAME IS IN EARLY BETA. THERE MAY BE BUGS

Notice: Servers may shut down during updates. Progress and balancing may change as the game continues to develop.
